requirement: The CLI must assign no application semantics to keys or references within `content`.
justification: Reviewed scenarios: Custom kind and references to nonexistent records remain ordinary JSON; no validation or scheduling semantics are attached. Creating a practice-shaped object leaves an existing due date untouched, and private serializer-looking keys remain literal objects.
